# Test Fixtures

## test_patients.json

Generated by `scripts/seed_synthea.py` after uploading Synthea FHIR R4 bundles.
Contains patient IDs uploaded to HAPI FHIR public server for integration testing.

Run:
```bash
python scripts/seed_synthea.py --dir path/to/synthea_fhir_r4/ --count 5
```

## synthea_patient.json (optional)

A single Synthea FHIR Bundle for offline unit tests.
